full_text:
Milos Nerlinger, PhD is a researcher working for the Organization.

== History ==
Milos Nerlinger was awarded a PhD. [TCG:LGS-021]

Milos was encountered by Dante Vale. Milos panicked when Dante destroyed 3.4 terabytes of hypogeal survey data. [TCG:LGS-021]

== Abilities ==
Although very cowardly, Milos excells in research and has a rather timid tactic of running away from battle.

Milos was encountered by [[Dante Vale]]. Milos panicked when Dante destroyed 3.4 terabytes of hypogeal survey data. {{Source|TCG:LGS-021|LGS-021}}

== Abilities ==
Although very cowardly, Milos excells in research and has a rather timid tactic of running away from battle.
